issues.title: Truncated Consolidated Findings File
issues.why: The file '02-consolidated-audit-findings/00-overview.md' is truncated mid-sentence at the 136KB cap, losing the final findings and the closing contract/verification sections.
issues.fix: Split the consolidated findings into multiple files (e.g., by severity or category) to ensure each file stays well under the context limit.

issues.title: Inconsistent Severity Enums in Superseded Module
issues.why: File '01-phase-2-git-logs-audit/00-overview.md' contains two competing severity enums (Critical/High vs Blocker/Major), which can confuse an AI coder on which to implement for the legacy parser.
issues.fix: Add a 'DEPRECATED' comment block next to the Phase 50 internal-audit-process enum in the overview.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'mem://' Protocol References
issues.why: The spec refers to 'mem://index.md' and 'mem://process/...' which are external to the provided context and not standard URI schemes.
issues.fix: Add a note in the Process Terminology glossary explaining that 'mem://' refers to the project's internal memory/knowledge-base files.
